entities.description: A black bicycle with silver handlebars and fenders is being ridden by a person wearing a colorful, patterned dress. The bicycle has thin tires and is positioned on a dirt path with greenery in the background.

A large, full burlap sack filled with yellow corn kernels sits on a dirt ground, with a person's hands gripping the top edge of the sack. The sack is made of coarse, light brown woven fabric and appears heavy and bulging from the contents.

A young Black boy with short black hair stands outdoors, wearing a yellow polo shirt with blue trim and dark blue shorts. He is leaning forward, using both hands to hold open the top of a large, full burlap sack filled with yellowish grains, looking down at the contents with a focused expression.

A smiling young Black woman is riding a black bicycle on a dirt path, wearing a pink short-sleeved t-shirt and a colorful patterned wrap skirt with orange, green, blue, and white designs. She has a vibrant, multicolored headwrap and is looking directly at the camera with a joyful expression.
